policy: The registry tables and forward-only compatibility migrations are defined in the exact reviewed shared-definitions revisions and applied verbatim by src/rust-orm/migrations.rs. Never replay the non-idempotent base segment when adding a migration. Do not author an independent schema in this crate. Schema changes are reviewed in ORESoftware/k8s-libs-and-shared-defs first, then vendored and repinned here.
